Time out killer. 110 volts at 15 amps is 1650 watts. Output from the welder will vary but still between 25 and 30 volts usually. That's 55 amps. Thats a lot of heat. Also, 1/4 inch IN A SINGLE PASS. You can very easily make multiple passes called stringers and fill in slowly for something larger. You may have to preheat the metal with a propane torch though depending on how big it is.

The other option is a getting a generator. A 5500 watt generator can be had for 600-800 bucks and can do well over 100 amps on a stick welder.
